sections.title: Objective type questions: each has two parts of 1 mark.

questions.q: State true or false: (i) Radio is a slow medium. (ii) One has to be literate to listen to radio.
Fill in the blanks: The three objectives of radio are to ______, ______ and ______.
Match: (i) Broadcaster (ii) Script (iii) Live broadcast (iv) Pre-recorded programme with (a) no pre-recording (b) written words to be spoken (c) recorded for later (d) presents programmes.
State true or false: (i) Radio messages are easily forgotten. (ii) Radio gives visual images.

sections.title: Very short answer questions. Answer in 30–50 words.

questions.q: What is meant by 'radio is a one-chance medium'?
questions.answer: A listener gets only one chance to hear and understand the spoken message, which cannot be re-read like print.

questions.q: Name any two characteristics of radio.
questions.answer: It makes pictures in the mind; it is fast, simple, inexpensive and portable.

questions.q: Define broadcasting.
questions.answer: Any communication or transmission of a message or signal to the public through electronic apparatus.

questions.q: Why is radio useful in rural areas?
questions.answer: It is cheap, battery run, needs no literacy and is the only source of news and entertainment for the rural majority.

sections.title: Short answer questions. Answer in 50–80 words.

questions.q: Briefly discuss any three limitations of radio broadcast.
questions.answer: It is a one-chance medium as the spoken word is momentary; it has no visual images so is less convincing than television; and messages are easily forgotten.

questions.q: Describe the objectives of radio with examples.
questions.answer: To inform (water supply announcements), to educate (agriculture programmes, Gyanvani) and to entertain (film songs).

questions.q: Explain why radio is called a medium that 'makes pictures'.
questions.answer: Listeners visualise scenes from sound, e.g. commentary on the Republic Day parade, using imagination.

sections.title: Long answer question. Answer in 80–120 words.

questions.q: Radio as a medium has certain characteristic features. Explain.
questions.answer: It makes pictures, is the fastest and simplest medium, inexpensive, runs on batteries, is portable, needs no literacy and serves the rural majority with music and news.

questions.q: Explain in detail the limitations of radio.
questions.answer: One-chance medium, no visuals, messages easily forgotten, poor announcers lose listeners, and no use for people with hearing disabilities.
